run_global_mining_pipeline: run the global mining pipeline to mine bitext pairs between source and target languages
process_language_embeddings: process a single language by computing embeddings and building FAISS indexes for mining
split_large_language: split a large language into smaller shards when it exceeds the maximum shard size threshold
mine_bitext_pairs: mine aligned sentence pairs between two languages using bidirectional distance calculation and index mining
merge_mined_pairs: merge multiple mined bitext pairs from different language shards into a single output file
